source_refs.note: Topic 3.6 Algorithm Design Techniques (PDF 81, printed 78). Short question 7 is answered.

blocks.text: Algorithm design means creating systematic methods to solve problems efficiently and effectively. Well-known techniques are divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming and backtracking.

blocks.prompt: Explain the importance of breaking a problem into smaller components in algorithmic thinking (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Small parts are easier to understand, solve and test one at a time; their solutions can be combined (divide and conquer) or reused (dynamic programming); work can be shared; and errors are easier to find. It turns a large, confusing problem into a sequence of manageable steps.

items: Design techniques: divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking.
